full_page.content:
1947, November 28
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap. ( from the photo copy)
November 28, 1947
Miss Doris Panyard 1st Street and Clay Ave. Muskegon, Michigan
The greatest science of all is that of our relationship with God and our Neighbor
RELIGION: Think it over and see if I am not right.
God Bless you Miss Doris:
Many thanks for your kind favor on the 25th . · The flower too. They came in good for Thanksgiving deco- ration on high-altar.
Hope Grace, George, Mother and all are well.
Praised be Jesus! Sincerely in Christ
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap.
Original in possession of: Doris Panyard 3248 Maple Grove Rd. Apt. 37 Muskegon, Mich. 49441
